[Download `01-getting-started.R`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thisisnic/ellmer-latinr/main/code/01-getting-started.R){.btn .btn-outline-primary .btn-sm} [View on GitHub](https://github.com/thisisnic/ellmer-latinr/blob/main/code/01-getting-started.R){.btn .btn-outline-primary .btn-sm}

```{.r filename="code/01-getting-started.R"}
# 1 - Getting Started with LLMs in R
# Using LLMs in R with ellmer - LatinR 2026

## Editing your .Renviron

usethis::edit_r_environ()

## Starting a conversation

library(ellmer)
chat <- chat_openrouter(model = "openai/gpt-6.1-terra")

## Sending a message to the LLM

library(ellmer)
chat <- chat_openrouter(model = "openai/gpt-6.1-terra")
chat$chat("What is the most popular dog breed in the world?
  Answer succinctly.")

## Turns

chat

## Continuing the conversation

chat$chat("What are they like to live with?")
chat$chat("How long do they usually live?")
chat

## Reset - just start a new chat

chat <- chat_openrouter(model = "openai/gpt-6.1-terra")
chat$chat("What were we saying earlier?")

## Chatting interactively

live_console(chat)   # type Q to quit
live_browser(chat)

chat
```
